command: $ps=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process; $targets=@($ps|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -match 'timeline_materializer\.py'}); foreach($t in $targets){Write-Output ("TIMELINE PID="+$t.ProcessId+" PPID="+$t.ParentProcessId+" CMD="+$t.CommandLine); $children=@($ps|Where-Object{$_.ParentProcessId -eq $t.ProcessId}); foreach($c in $children){Write-Output ("  CHILD PID="+$c.ProcessId+" NAME="+$c.Name+" CMD="+$c.CommandLine)}}; Write-Output ("TOTAL_TIMELINE="+$targets.Count)
